Attached: 1 image

n8n builders: your workflow can answer the phone.
1. POST api.callnode.io/v1/numbers → live US/CA number2. call.answered webhook hits your n8n Webhook node3. The workflow runs — qualify the caller, check the calendar, look up the order4. POST the reply back → spoken to the caller
No telephony nodes to learn. It's the same HTTP you already orchestrate.
#VoiceAI #AIAgents
